scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.resolve(__dirname, '../catalog'); const dst = path.resolve(__dirname, 'catalog'); const dstDist = path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist/catalog'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.cpSync(src, dst, { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync(src, dstDist, { recursive: true }); }"
